selected_evidence.requirement: Local logins display “Authorized access only” before authentication
selected_evidence.summary: agetty directly rendered the required warning before and after restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: SSH logins display “Authorized access only” before authentication
selected_evidence.summary: Credential-free SSH probes to 10.100.127.10 displayed the warning before returning authentication failure, both before and after restart.

Healthy baseline boot ID e625b9a5-4242-499a-88da-9a76ecf86fe1 was captured; the safe reboot was acknowledged; the new boot ID 9f2cf5f3-3d06-4f7f-8ea1-c6544378d4a1 was observed; system state, sshd, listener, configuration, and both banner paths recovered successfully.
